name: quality repetition: re-asked topic gets a fresh answer

turns.text: What do you know about Costa Rica?
Tell me something about Costa Rica.

judge.rubric: says something about Costa Rica that is NOT the same as its earlier answer — new detail or new angle

turns.text: And your favorite season, what was it?

judge.rubric: answers consistently with its earlier stated season but phrased differently, not copy-pasted
